records.name: Gimmick Card
records.acquisition: Pick up the green Mickey card during a supported boss battle. Its value is 0; it cannot be broken or stocked. Use it to create an opening against the boss.

notes.title: Guard Armor
notes.text: Break a boss card: 30% chance. Using the Gimmick Card leaves the armor collapsed for 10 seconds.

notes.title: Trickmaster
notes.text: Break a boss card after the furniture is destroyed: 30% chance. The card restores the table and chair.

notes.title: Jafar
notes.text: Hit Jafar’s body with ice for a guaranteed card, or break a boss card for a 25% chance. The card raises all platforms until his next two moves finish.

notes.title: Parasite Cage
notes.text: Break a boss card: 30% chance. The card removes the acid and platforms and prevents Dark Spray and Both Hands Strike for 10 seconds.

notes.title: Oogie Boogie
notes.text: Break his Dice attack and destroy a die: 50% chance. The card lowers the fence and holds Oogie still for 13 seconds.

notes.title: Ursula
notes.text: Destroy a tentacle: 25% chance. The card removes her remaining tentacles and exposes her head for 8 seconds.

notes.title: Dragon Maleficent
notes.text: Break a boss card: 30% chance. The card creates a platform for 8 seconds; boarding it gives you 17 seconds to steer it.

notes.title: Darkside
notes.text: Destroy every Shadow from Dark Punch for a guaranteed card. The card raises steps to his head and stops him moving for 17 seconds.
